nav.label: Finders
draw.intro: Draw one grapheme, not a whole block. The closest shapes appear after each stroke.
draw.failed: The shapes could not be loaded.
draw.empty: Draw a stroke to see candidates.
draw.keys: Enter writes the first candidate and Esc clears the pad. A click opens a grapheme; a double click writes it.
draw.note: This compares your ink with one printed face, so close shapes can trade places. Graphemes without a code point cannot be found here.
nav.blocks.hint: Your text as written on stone
settings.label: Settings
theme.label: Theme
lang.label: Language
writing.label: The text being written
find.intro: Paste Khitan, or type a reading, a catalogue number, a code point, a meaning or a Chinese word.
find.label: Search
syllabary.intro: Otake's values, vowels across and codas down. A click opens a grapheme; a double click writes it.
graphemes.intro: Every grapheme in the catalogue and every character Unicode encodes.
graphemes.unicodeOnly: In Unicode, not in the catalogue
reading.intro: Type a reading, with phonetic letters or plain ones. A digit picks a candidate; space or a hyphen writes the first.
reading.label: Reading
words.intro: Words cited in Otake's work. Open a row for its evidence.
words.label: Search words
words.placeholder: A form, a meaning or a Chinese word
sentences.intro: Sentences from the inscriptions, with transcription, gloss and translation.
sentences.source: 大竹昌巳 (2018) 「契丹語を俯瞰する」例文集.
blocks.intro: A space ends a word; a new line starts a column. Graphemes pair left to right and top to bottom.
blocks.empty: The text is empty. Choose graphemes in any finder.
large.intro: The large script is not in Unicode, so these characters use BabelStone's Private Use code points. Text copied here needs that font.
large.label: Search reconstructions
large.placeholder: A reconstruction, a Chinese character or a meaning
large.source: Liu Fengzhu and Wang Yunlong (2004), Appendix I, as transcribed by Andrew West.
documents.intro: An abbreviation such as D.CAL 53 cites line 53 of one of these. Listed in Otake (2020).
documents.title: Title
about.intro: Grapheme values follow 大竹昌巳 (Otake Masami). Other scholars' values stand beside them under their own names.
tier.stated_unattested.note: Marked *: no use with this value is attested.
tier.single_grapheme_word.note: Taken from a word written with this grapheme alone; it may be a whole word's reading.
tier.aligned_spelling.note: Aligned from a segmented spelling; the weakest evidence here.
card.label: The open grapheme
card.blank: Choose a grapheme to read its record.
card.variantOf: Otake counts this as a variant of {id}.
card.jurchen: Unicode's names list marks this as tentatively Jurchen Small Script.
link.west_1985_number: Unicode link by the 1985 number in West's mapping table.
link.west_1985_renumbered: Unicode link through a replaced 1985 number in West's mapping table.
link.visual: Unicode link judged by eye against Noto Serif Khitan Small Script.
link.none: No Unicode character has been matched to this grapheme.
link.unicodeOnly: In Unicode, with no number in Otake's catalogue.
confidence.medium: Close neighbours exist, so check it.
app.sponsor.label: Sponsor
app.sponsor.lead: I build Khitan Input on my own, with no funding behind it. It's free for everyone, and I'd like to keep it that way.
app.sponsor.ask: If Khitan Input is useful to you, a tip gives me time to keep improving it.
app.sponsor.step3: Pay by card. No sign-up needed.
app.sponsor.thanks: Thank you for using Khitan Input 💗
